thread:
maria: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem: token-validator GC pause caused JWKS fetch to block — led to validation failures. Need owners/timelines for hotfix, audit events, secrets rotation, and a brief recurrence cadence. Put commits in this sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AuthzActions

devsec-bot: INCIDENT RDW-2026-318 recorded: authz token validation spike 2026-03-22 11:12-11:48 UTC. Impact: hosted API + some eu-west-1 dedicated customers. Severity P2. Logs: https://logs.redwood.example/incident/2026-318

jamie: I'll take the hotfix: add cache fallback + simple circuit-breaker around JWKS fetch. Target: patch -> staging by 03/26 EOD, canary 03/27 morning.

alex: I'll own telemetry/alerts and the audit event. Plan to add jwks_fetch_latency histogram and authz.audit events with token_hash and verdict. PR today.

tanya: I'll draft customer-facing notes and wait for jamie's canary success before sending.

maria: Sheet rows added. Please add sub-tasks by EOD tomorrow. Proposed dates: hotfix 03/26, telemetry+audit 03/28, rotate service principal 03/28 window.

jamie: Short-term mitigations: tune G1 pause targets, reduce heap; make JWKS fetch non-blocking. Longer-term: move JWKS fetch to a tiny sidecar with independent process limits.

alex: Query to separate tenant vs platform failures:
```
index=authz.audit error_code=* | stats count by error_code, tenant_id
```
Will add fields: tenant_id, token_hash, jwks_fetch_latency_ms, cached_jwks_age_s.

devsec-bot: Remediation ticket RDW-SEC-12458 created for service principal rotation and secret verification. Proposed window 03/28 02:00-04:00 UTC.

maria: Proposing a short "token health" check: weekly 15-min sync for 6 weeks starting Mon 03/30. I'll send invites. Ack owners in the sheet please.

jamie: :eyes: confirmed. Dropping runbook snippet into the sheet now:
```
# fallback snippet
if jwks_fetch_latency_ms > 500:
  use_cached_jwks()
  backoff_jwks_fetch()
  emit_metric("jwks.fetch.fail")
if cached_jwks_age_s > 60:
  page("eng-oncall")
```
Will expand to full runbook by EOD Fri.

tanya: ok. I'll hold comms until runbook + canary success. Add me to owner column.

maria: Recap of immediate owners: jamie=hotfix+runbook (03/26), alex=telemetry+audit (03/28), devsec=rotate secrets (03/28), tanya=comms after canary. Update sheet if dates slide and ping me. Thanks.
